system.name: UAS Weapon System FQT
system.description: The UAS Weapon System is a multi-segment intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) system composed of four operational segments with lower-level components inside each segment.

subsystems.name: UAS Air Vehicle Segment
subsystems.description: Airborne platform carrying sensor payloads and command relay functions

subsystems.name: Satellite Communications Terminal
subsystems.description: Ground relay and crypto gateway for all air-to-ground traffic

subsystems.name: Navigation Subsystem
subsystems.description: Provides position and attitude data to the mission computer

subsystems.name: Processing Subsystem
subsystems.description: Executes mission payloads and sensor fusion

subsystems.name: Encryption Gateway Subsystem
subsystems.description: Performs in-line encryption and decryption of all satellite link traffic

subsystems.name: Traffic Shaping Subsystem
subsystems.description: Controls data flow rates and priority queuing for the satellite link

subsystems.name: Diagnostic Computer Subsystem
subsystems.description: Hosts maintenance workstation software and provides the technician HMI for fault isolation and health monitoring

subsystems.name: Software Load Station Subsystem
subsystems.description: Manages storage integrity verification and transfer of authorised software loads to Alpha

subsystems.name: Test Interface Module Subsystem
subsystems.description: Physical and logical interface between the GMS and the Alpha maintenance port

components.name: Flight Control Computer
components.description: Executes autonomous flight logic and consumes navigation

components.name: Payload Controller
components.description: Manages sensor payload collection and mission-mode selection

components.name: Telemetry Router
components.description: Formats telemetry and command acknowledgements for the satellite link

components.name: Aircraft Key Store
components.description: Stores link keys and command authorization material

components.name: Mission Processing Server
components.description: Runs payload analytics and intelligence fusion jobs

components.name: Intelligence Storage Cluster
components.description: Retains mission outputs

components.name: Dissemination Gateway
components.description: Publishes approved products to downstream consumers and maintenance services

components.name: Operator Analyst Workstation
components.description: Issues tasking updates and reviews processed mission results

components.name: Satcom Modem
components.description: Handles encrypted RF relay between the air vehicle and ground segments

components.name: Crypto Gateway
components.description: Performs AES-256-GCM encryption and decryption for the satellite link

components.name: Key Management Module
components.description: Maintains session keys and rotation state for the relay boundary

components.name: Maintenance Test Set
components.description: Performs diagnostic queries and validation checks on the air vehicle

components.name: Software Load Manager
components.description: Stages and transfers authenticated software packages to the air vehicle

components.name: Diagnostics Recorder
components.description: Captures HUMS data

components.name: GPS Receiver
components.description: Acquires satellite signals and outputs position fixes

components.name: Inertial Measurement Unit
components.description: Measures angular rate and acceleration

components.name: Command Processor
components.description: Parses and validates operator uplink messages

components.name: Mission Computer
components.description: Runs payload algorithms and logs results

components.name: Solid State Recorder
components.description: Records high-rate sensor data

components.name: Key Management Module
components.description: Manages encryption keys for stored data

components.name: Bulk Encryption Module
components.description: Applies AES-256-GCM encryption and decryption to satellite data frames

components.name: Key Distribution Module
components.description: Receives keying material and distributes keys to the encryption module on schedule

components.name: Traffic Shaper
components.description: Manages queuing, prioritization, and rate limiting for satellite link data

components.name: Maintenance Workstation
components.description: Technician HMI presenting BIT results fault codes calibration data and maintenance history

components.name: Maintenance Data Recorder
components.description: Encrypted local storage for all maintenance session logs BIT results and HUMS downloads

components.name: Software Load Controller
components.description: Manages software baseline for all loadable software parts and coordinates with Bravo for approved packages

components.name: Load Verification Module
components.description: Executes post-load integrity checks by reading back installed part numbers and checksums

components.name: Bus Controller
components.description: Manages MIL-STD-1553 bus master operations and schedules message transfers to Alpha LRUs

components.name: RS-422 Serial Interface
components.description: Low-speed serial channel for Alpha LRUs that do not support MIL-STD-1553

stride.S_justification: Spoofed RF source can inject false telemetry on satcom link.
stride.T_justification: Tampering possible if encryption keys are compromised.
stride.R_justification: Limited non-repudiation on RF downlink traffic.
stride.I_justification: Sensor and health data highly sensitive ISR payload.
stride.D_justification: Jamming or denial disrupts critical ISR downlink.
stride.E_justification: Boundary crossing allows potential privilege abuse via spoofed frames.

threats.name: Satellite Link Jamming
threats.description: Adversary jams or spoofs the encrypted RF downlink to corrupt telemetry and sensor data reaching the ground station.

mitigations_technical.title: Anti-Jam Antenna and Spread Spectrum
mitigations_technical.description: Deploy frequency-hopping and null-steering antennas to mitigate RF jamming on satcom link.

mitigations_administrative.title: Jamming Detection and Fallback Procedure
mitigations_administrative.description: Crew procedure to detect link degradation and switch to alternate comms path.

stride.S_justification: Spoofed uplink commands can hijack flight control.
stride.T_justification: Tampered commands directly affect vehicle safety.
stride.R_justification: Limited audit of RF command origin.
stride.D_justification: Loss of uplink prevents mission abort or control.
stride.E_justification: Compromised auth token enables elevated command execution.

threats.name: Command Injection via Spoofed Uplink
threats.description: Adversary injects forged command messages on the satcom uplink to seize control of the air vehicle.

mitigations_technical.title: Mutual Authentication with Nonces
mitigations_technical.description: Enforce nonce-based mutual auth and hardware-backed signing for all uplink commands.

mitigations_administrative.title: Command Authorization SOP
mitigations_administrative.description: Two-person rule and pre-flight key ceremony for command authorization tokens.

stride.S_justification: Spoofed ground station can feed false mission data.
stride.I_justification: Decrypted frames expose sensitive mission content.
stride.D_justification: Disruption delays intelligence dissemination.
stride.E_justification: Limited escalation path through TLS endpoint.

threats.name: False ISR Data Injection
threats.description: Adversary spoofs the dissemination gateway to feed fabricated mission data into the processing server.

mitigations_technical.title: TLS Client Certificate Pinning
mitigations_technical.description: Enforce certificate pinning and mTLS for all gateway-to-server connections.

mitigations_administrative.title: Data Origin Validation Procedure
mitigations_administrative.description: Operator validation checklist for incoming mission data frames.

stride.S_justification: Spoofed analyst workstation can issue rogue tasking.
stride.R_justification: Operator session logs exist but are incomplete.
stride.D_justification: Loss of tasking channel delays mission changes.
stride.E_justification: Valid session can escalate to payload control.

threats.name: Rogue Tasking Injection
threats.description: Compromised workstation issues malicious waypoint or payload mode changes over the TLS link.

mitigations_technical.title: Command Signing and Validation
mitigations_technical.description: Require hardware-backed digital signatures on all tasking messages.

mitigations_administrative.title: Tasking Approval Workflow
mitigations_administrative.description: Dual-approval workflow for all flight-critical waypoint and payload changes.

stride.S_justification: Spoofed maintenance set can send unauthorized BIT commands.
stride.T_justification: Tampered commands affect vehicle health state.
stride.D_justification: Flood of queries can saturate bus.
stride.E_justification: Valid session token enables deeper maintenance access.

threats.name: Unauthorized BIT Command Injection
threats.description: Spoofed maintenance test set issues rogue 1553 BIT commands altering LRU state.

mitigations_technical.title: 1553 Bus Authentication Tokens
mitigations_technical.description: Implement authenticated command tokens on 1553 maintenance bus.

mitigations_administrative.title: Maintenance Access Log Review
mitigations_administrative.description: Mandatory post-session log review and anomaly reporting.

stride.S_justification: Spoofed source can inject false HUMS records.
stride.I_justification: Flight logs contain sensitive mission history.
stride.D_justification: Bus saturation prevents timely download.
stride.E_justification: No direct privilege escalation on this interface.

threats.name: False HUMS Log Injection
threats.description: Adversary injects fabricated HUMS and fault data over the 1553 bus to conceal actual vehicle issues.

mitigations_technical.title: HUMS Data Signing
mitigations_technical.description: Sign all HUMS records with aircraft key before transmission.

mitigations_administrative.title: HUMS Integrity Audit
mitigations_administrative.description: Independent review of HUMS downloads for anomalies.

stride.S_justification: Spoofed load station can deliver malicious software.
stride.T_justification: Tampered package executes on payload controller.
stride.D_justification: Corrupt load can brick payload functions.
stride.E_justification: Successful load grants code execution privileges.

threats.name: Malicious Software Load via RS-422
threats.description: Spoofed load station delivers a malicious software package over RS-422 that executes on the payload controller.

mitigations_technical.title: RS-422 Secure Loader with Signature Check
mitigations_technical.description: Require cryptographic signature verification before executing any loaded package.

mitigations_administrative.title: Software Load Authorization
mitigations_administrative.description: Pre-load authorization by security officer with manifest review.

stride.S_justification: Spoofed dissemination gateway can push rogue packages.
stride.T_justification: Unsigned or altered packages bypass integrity checks.
stride.D_justification: Flood can delay legitimate software distribution.
stride.E_justification: Valid signature allows code execution on target.

threats.name: Rogue Software Package Push
threats.description: Compromised dissemination gateway pushes a malicious signed package to the software load manager.

mitigations_technical.title: Gateway-to-Loader mTLS and Package Hash
mitigations_technical.description: Enforce mTLS plus manifest hash verification on all package transfers.

mitigations_administrative.title: Package Distribution Approval
mitigations_administrative.description: Security review and sign-off before any package is released to load stations.

stride.S_justification: Spoofed recorder can inject false logs.
stride.I_justification: Logs contain system health and fault data.
stride.D_justification: Flooding delays log aggregation.
stride.E_justification: No privilege escalation via log sync.

stride.S_justification: Spoofed KMM can distribute false keys.
stride.T_justification: Tampered keys break all link encryption.
stride.R_justification: Key rotation events have limited non-repudiation.
stride.I_justification: Key material directly exposes crypto boundary.
stride.D_justification: Key revocation flood disrupts all links.
stride.E_justification: Compromised keys enable full traffic control.

threats.name: Key Material Tampering
threats.description: Spoofed key management module distributes compromised keys breaking all satcom encryption.

mitigations_technical.title: Hardware Security Module Key Wrapping
mitigations_technical.description: Wrap and store all keys in HSM with attestation before distribution.

mitigations_administrative.title: Key Ceremony and Rotation Schedule
mitigations_administrative.description: Formal key ceremony with witnessed rotation and revocation procedures.

stride.S_justification: Spoofed GPS signals can supply false position.
stride.R_justification: No logging of internal GPS feed.
stride.D_justification: Loss of GPS feed degrades navigation accuracy.
stride.E_justification: No elevation path on internal UDP link.

threats.name: GPS Signal Spoofing
threats.description: Adversary broadcasts counterfeit GPS signals corrupting position data fed to the command processor.

mitigations_technical.title: RAIM and Cryptographic GPS Authentication
mitigations_technical.description: Enable receiver autonomous integrity monitoring and authenticated GPS signals.

mitigations_administrative.title: GPS Degradation Response Procedure
mitigations_administrative.description: Switch to inertial navigation on detected GPS anomaly.

stride.S_justification: Physical tampering required to spoof IMU.
stride.T_justification: SPI bus susceptible to bit-flip attacks.
stride.R_justification: No audit on internal SPI bus.
stride.I_justification: Raw IMU data has low sensitivity.
stride.D_justification: Loss of IMU data affects attitude control.
stride.E_justification: No privilege escalation on hardware bus.

threats.name: IMU Data Tampering via Bus Attack
threats.description: Adversary performs bit-flip or physical tampering on the SPI bus to corrupt IMU telemetry.

mitigations_technical.title: SPI Bus CRC and Physical Shielding
mitigations_technical.description: Add CRC checks and physical tamper-evident shielding on IMU SPI bus.

mitigations_administrative.title: IMU Health Monitoring SOP
mitigations_administrative.description: Routine cross-check of IMU data against GPS/INS during pre-flight.

stride.S_justification: Spoofed GCS can issue rogue flight commands.
stride.T_justification: Tampered commands directly affect flight safety.
stride.D_justification: Loss of uplink severs operator control.
stride.E_justification: Valid token enables elevated command access.

threats.name: Spoofed GCS Command Injection
threats.description: Adversary spoofs the GCS to inject malicious commands over the TLS radio link.

mitigations_technical.title: GCS Certificate Pinning and Token Binding
mitigations_technical.description: Pin GCS certificates and bind tokens to hardware identity.

mitigations_administrative.title: GCS Access Control and Audit
mitigations_administrative.description: Strict access control list and real-time command auditing from GCS.

stride.S_justification: Internal PCIe link requires physical access.
stride.D_justification: Loss of storage path drops recording.
stride.E_justification: No elevation on internal hardware link.

stride.S_justification: Internal I2C requires physical access.
stride.D_justification: Bus contention can block key writes.
stride.E_justification: No privilege escalation on internal bus.

stride.S_justification: Spoofed remote ops can request diagnostics.
stride.D_justification: Flood of requests can degrade performance.
stride.E_justification: Limited escalation via diagnostic interface.

threats.name: Remote Diagnostics Spoofing
threats.description: Spoofed remote operations endpoint injects false diagnostic requests or reports.

mitigations_technical.title: Remote Ops mTLS and Request Signing
mitigations_technical.description: Require signed requests and mTLS for all remote diagnostics.

mitigations_administrative.title: Remote Diagnostics Access Policy
mitigations_administrative.description: Time-limited access tokens and post-session review for remote diagnostics.

stride.S_justification: Spoofing requires internal network access.
stride.T_justification: Tampered BIT commands affect LRU state.
stride.D_justification: Flood of commands saturates bus.
stride.E_justification: Valid token allows deeper maintenance access.

stride.S_justification: Spoofed bus controller can issue rogue BIT.
stride.D_justification: Bus flooding disrupts maintenance.
stride.E_justification: Session token enables privileged LRU access.

threats.name: Rogue 1553 BIT Command
threats.description: Spoofed bus controller issues malicious 1553 BIT commands to alter LRU behavior.

mitigations_technical.title: 1553 Command Whitelisting
mitigations_technical.description: Whitelist only approved BIT commands on the maintenance bus controller.

mitigations_administrative.title: BIT Command Logging and Review
mitigations_administrative.description: Log and review all 1553 BIT commands executed during maintenance.

stride.S_justification: Spoofed LRU can return false status.
stride.D_justification: Flood of responses saturates bus.
stride.E_justification: No escalation on status response.

stride.S_justification: Spoofed port can inject false HUMS.
stride.D_justification: Bus saturation blocks download.
stride.E_justification: No privilege escalation via download.

threats.name: False HUMS Injection on 1553
threats.description: Spoofed maintenance port injects fabricated HUMS data to conceal real faults.

mitigations_technical.title: HUMS Record Signing on LRU
mitigations_technical.description: Sign HUMS records at LRU level before 1553 transmission.

mitigations_administrative.title: HUMS Validation Checklist
mitigations_administrative.description: Cross-verify HUMS data against known flight events during download.

stride.S_justification: Internal bus spoofing requires physical access.
stride.D_justification: Internal link loss has limited impact.
stride.E_justification: No elevation path on internal bus.

stride.S_justification: Spoofed Bravo can push malicious packages.
stride.D_justification: Flood delays legitimate loads.
stride.E_justification: Valid signature grants code execution.

threats.name: Malicious Package Distribution
threats.description: Spoofed Bravo dissemination pushes a malicious signed software package to the load station.

mitigations_technical.title: Package Signature and Hash Verification
mitigations_technical.description: Verify digital signature and manifest hash on every received package.

mitigations_administrative.title: Software Release Sign-off
mitigations_administrative.description: Security and engineering sign-off required prior to package release.

stride.S_justification: Spoofed verifier can report false results.
stride.D_justification: Loss has minor operational impact.
stride.E_justification: No escalation via verification report.

stride.S_justification: Spoofed controller can load malicious code.
stride.T_justification: Tampered package executes on aircraft LRUs.
stride.D_justification: Corrupt load can disable LRUs.
stride.E_justification: Successful load grants execution privileges.

threats.name: Malicious 1553 Software Load
threats.description: Spoofed bus controller loads malicious software package onto aircraft LRUs via 1553.

mitigations_technical.title: 1553 Load with Dual Signature Check
mitigations_technical.description: Require dual signatures and sequence validation before executing 1553 software load.

mitigations_administrative.title: Load Authorization and Witnessing
mitigations_administrative.description: Require witnessed authorization for all 1553 software loads.

interfaces.description: Software Load to Alpha via RS-422

stride.S_justification: Spoofed RS-422 source can inject bad loads.
stride.T_justification: Tampered package executes on target LRU.
stride.D_justification: Corrupt load disables payload functions.
stride.E_justification: Successful load grants code execution.

threats.name: Malicious RS-422 Software Load
threats.description: Spoofed RS-422 interface injects malicious software package onto target LRU.

mitigations_technical.title: RS-422 Secure Boot Loader
mitigations_technical.description: Enforce secure boot and checksum verification on RS-422 loads.

mitigations_administrative.title: Load Session Logging and Approval
mitigations_administrative.description: Log every RS-422 load session with approval sign-off.

interfaces.description: Maintenance Session Log Sync to Bravo

stride.S_justification: Spoofed recorder can inject false logs.
stride.I_justification: Logs contain technician and fault data.
stride.D_justification: Loss has minor operational impact.
stride.E_justification: No escalation via log sync.
